maya (Docs): quick heads-up — PR #452 is ready but I want an engineering sanity check on the snippets we added to the Optimize toolkit page. main problems i've spotted: the JS example still uses the old batch API, and the python example is missing the KV-prefetch note.
liam (Eng): on it. can you paste the two snippets here? will run a quick smoke test locally.
maya (Docs): pasted below — JS first, then python. please check the call surface + imported helpers.
```js
// old snippet in PR: uses batch.create (deprecated)
const batch = client.batch.create({maxTokens: 512})
const resp = await batch.run(prompt)
```
```py
# python example missing kv prefetch guidance (we recommend prefetch for repeated prefixes)
resp = client.generate(model="redwood/fast-ggml", prompt=prompt, max_tokens=512)
```
rachel (Runtime): FYI runtime no longer exposes batch.create — use client.batch.request or the streaming helper. also if you expect short repeated prefixes, add KV prefetch: `client.cache.prefetch(prefixes)` to avoid repeated KV compute.
liam (Eng): thanks — small changes. suggested JS patch: `const resp = await client.batch.request({inputs: [prompt], max_tokens:512})` and add a short note about sequence length distribution. will open a tiny fix PR against docs branch.
serena (ML): +1 on KV-prefetch note. also for the quant profile section, call out that q4_0 and q8_0 have different accuracy regressions for generation vs. embeddings — i added a one-liner suggestion in PR comments.
deploy-bot: CI (docs-lint) passed for PR #452 (build 1189) :white_check_mark:
maya (Docs): awesome — liam, can you drop the fix PR number here when ready? i'll update the migration checklist and the changelog blurb.
liam (Eng): opened #453 with the minimal snippet replacements and a link-fix for the SDK reference. leaving for maya to merge after quick review.
maya (Docs): merging after i confirm one tiny wording tweak. thanks all — tagging this as done in the docs board :tada:
